      Changelog — v1.3 · 2026-07-30

      • v1.3 map pins + filters: Pins are colour discs by vs national average (±3 pp bands) — no rank digits. Toolbar: min/max score %, vs-national select, weak section (below that section’s country avg). Click a pin to open Dealer radar.
      • v1.2 with map: Map tab — Leaflet + OpenStreetMap / CARTO pins for the full IDS network; hover shows dealer score %, country national average %, and delta (pp).
      • MIDI FR/IT/ES/CH geo: Pins use MIDI_FR.xlsx NETWORK Town + Latitude/Longitude (exact DLRName match). Switzerland uses NETWORK Town city centres when lat/lon are blank. Removes the country-centre jitter blobs for those four countries.
      • UK CV geo: Extra city pins from Isuzu Truck UK store pages / public dealer addresses for residual names without an Address row.
      • Map fitBounds: Europe/Israel core only on open — French overseas dealers (Réunion / Martinique / Mayotte) stay on the map when MIDI NETWORK confirms them; zoom out or filter to France to see them. Réunion is labelled Saint-Pierre (Réunion), not Madagascar. Sanity fails if a non-overseas drawn pin sits outside country bounds.
      • City-token scope: Country-scoped tokens (e.g. Sofia) cannot false-place a Greece dealer in Bulgaria.
      • Poland geo fix: Pins use city centres inferred from the IDS result-report Address row (Toruń, Warszawa, Kraków, Poznań, Gdynia, …) — not the country-centre jitter blob near Łódź.
      • Network geo + sanity: Address-row city matching expanded (Greece, Belgium, Denmark, Norway, UK LCV, NL, …); word-boundary tokens (no Bilboel→Bilbao); builder geo sanity warns on country-centre blobs / tight clusters and fails if Poland/Portugal/Greece/Belgium/France/Italy/Spain/Switzerland city coverage regresses.
      • Radar charts: removed dark “Weak sector” overlay wedges and floating Weak labels — clean dealer / country / network polygons only.
      • All UI labels in English (good / medium / bad — no Dutch goed/slecht).
      • Country names in English: Switzerland / France / Italy / Spain (not MIDI_CH etc.).
      • UK LCV (IUK — I.M. Parts & Service, D-Max), UK CV (ITUK — Isuzu Truck UK), Israel LCV (UMI IDS pack — never blended with UTI), Norway (RSA).
      • Benelux kept; Belgium, Netherlands and Luxembourg also shown as separate countries (map prefers non-Benelux pins when both exist).
      • Overview strengths / weak points: per section A–E, based on max-point items (full score = good, zero = bad) — not “first question in section”.
      • Dealer total score shown as percentage (Score % of 280). Network GPS capture is not hardcoded here (Portugal meeting lock 63.3% stays on the Portugal / Imotors pack only).
